constraints: Stripe is the only payment method Ko-fi offers, so every contribution lands in Alan's own Stripe account and nothing is read from Ko-fi.
Ko-fi takes the money, because Patreon's terms forbid leading a contributor from Patreon to Alan's own site, which this model requires.

intentStack.statement: A payment Stripe reports lands the contributor's page and the contribution points it earns.
A refund or dispute Stripe reports posts a negative transaction against the contributor.
intentStack.workingMemory: Ko-fi reports no cancellation, refund or chargeback, and says so itself. Stripe does, because Alan is the merchant rather than Ko-fi.
